name: Animate.css
summary: CSS library of ready-to-use animation classes: attention seekers, entrances, exits and more.
description: A cross-browser CSS animation library applied with classes like animate__animated and animate__fadeInUp. Animations are grouped into attention seekers, back/bouncing/fading/sliding/zooming/rotating entrances and exits, flippers, lightspeed and specials, with docs for installation, delay/speed/repeat utility classes, CSS custom properties, custom builds and accessibility.
contains: animation classes grouped into attention seekers, entrances, exits, flippers, lightspeed, specials and more
install via npm, Yarn or CDN and apply with animate__ utility classes
delay, speed and repeat classes plus CSS custom properties for duration and delay
documentation: custom builds, JavaScript usage, best practices, accessibility
